manager_lead: Install any mod from SOTF Mods in one click, get whole modpacks, keep everything updated and switch between mod profiles. It also installs RedLoader for you.
manager_requirements: Windows 10 and 11 · Free and open source · Nothing to install
manager_features_title: Everything you need to mod the game
manager_feature_oneclick_text: Click «Install with SotF Mods Manager» on any mod page and the manager downloads it with its dependencies.
manager_feature_modpacks_text: Open a modpack from the site and it becomes a new profile with all its mods, ready to play.
manager_feature_updates_text: See which mods have a new version and update them with one button.
manager_feature_profiles_text: Keep separate mod sets for solo and multiplayer and switch between them instantly.
manager_feature_redloader_text: Install, repair or update RedLoader, the mod loader, without touching the game files yourself.
manager_feature_crash_text: If the game crashes, the manager opens the logs so you can find the mod that caused it.
manager_shot_main: SotF Mods Manager showing the mods of SOTF Mods
manager_step_1: Download SotfModsManager.exe and open it. It finds your game through Steam.
manager_step_2: Click Install in the top bar if RedLoader is missing.
manager_step_3: Install mods or a modpack, then click Play.
manager_smartscreen: Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time because the exe is not signed: click More info, then Run anyway. The source code is public on GitHub.
manager_meta_title: SotF Mods Manager: one-click mod manager for Sons of the Forest
manager_meta_description: Free mod manager for Sons of the Forest. Install mods and modpacks from SOTF Mods in one click, keep them updated and switch between profiles.
manager_hero_title: The new way to install Sons of the Forest mods
manager_compare_text: Installing mods by hand works, but it is slow and easy to get wrong. The manager does every step for you.
manager_old_1: Find the mod and download a zip
manager_old_2: Extract it into the right game folder
manager_old_3: Hunt down every library it needs
manager_old_4: Repeat all of it for every update
manager_new_2: Dependencies come along on their own
manager_new_4: Install a whole modpack in one click
manager_final_text: Download SotF Mods Manager, pick your mods or a modpack and play. Free, open source and made for SOTF Mods.
